name: Adonis
instructions: Add sherry, sweet vermouth, and orange bitters to a mixing glass with ice. Stir for 15-20 seconds until chilled. Strain into a chilled coupe or cocktail glass. Garnish with an orange twist.

name: House Margarita
instructions: Shake tequila, lime juice, and orange liqueur with ice. Strain into a salt-rimmed glass over fresh ice. Garnish with a lime wheel.
